summary: This directory centralizes the definition of foundational configuration types and interfaces, establishing the schema-based structure, resolution strategies, and metadata requirements for managing application settings across various environment, file, and runtime sources.
responsibilities: Categorize configuration resolution sources and strategies
Specify requirements for loaded configuration metadata
Facilitate type safety for runtime and static configuration requests
relationships: Configuration requests utilize specific resolution modes to determine how settings are retrieved from defined sources.
Loaded configuration objects encapsulate raw data alongside metadata describing their origin layer and source.
Static and runtime request interfaces differentiate between environment-based or file-based retrieval and dynamic runtime inputs.
Partial configuration types support the incremental assembly of settings across different hierarchical layers.
designDecisions: Strict type-based definition of configuration structure derived from schema
Explicit separation between static resolution and runtime configuration requests
Hierarchical layer modeling for configuration priority
Generic support for metadata-enriched configuration records
